symptom: `authentication microflow Module.Auth` on a published OData service parses, checks clean and reports `Created OData service` — then the build fails **CE0333** "Please select a microflow to use for authentication", and `DESCRIBE` shows `authentication Microflow` with no name. Custom authentication is unreachable from MDL, which matters because it is the only way to avoid a full BCrypt hash on every OData request (60–80% of a page turn measured)
cause: The grammar had accepted `MICROFLOW qualifiedName?` all along and both writers already serialized `AuthenticationMicroflow` from `svc.AuthMicroflow` — but nothing ever *assigned* it. `parseODataAuthTypes` recognised the `microflow` keyword and discarded the name, so the field was only ever populated by reading a model Studio Pro wrote. DESCRIBE then emitted it as a comment (`-- Auth Microflow: …`), so a custom-auth service could not round-trip either
file: `mdl/ast/ast_odata.go` (`AuthMicroflow`), `mdl/visitor/visitor_odata.go` (`parseODataAuthTypes` returns the name), `mdl/executor/cmd_odata.go` (assign on create AND modify; `odataAuthClause` for DESCRIBE), `mdl/executor/validate_odata_auth.go` (MDL-ODATA04)
insight: **When a feature "silently drops" one field, check whether the plumbing already exists at both ends** — here only the middle assignment was missing, so the fix was ~10 lines across four files rather than a new write path. The grammar already parsed the name: `at.QualifiedName()` was simply never read. **DESCRIBE emitting a value as a comment is the same defect class as dropping it** (§39): the output looks complete and replays into a model the build rejects — so the round-trip test asserts the emitted clause re-parses to the same microflow, not that it contains some text. Two Mendix rules bound the feature and are easy to hit while verifying: **CE0333** if no microflow is named (now MDL-ODATA04 at check time), and **CE6600** "App security is off, but custom authentication is enabled" — so a fixture project needs `alter project security level prototype` before it can prove anything. That second one is why this is NOT in the doctype gate: those projects run with security off, so any custom-auth service there fails CE6600 regardless of correctness. Verified instead by writing the service from MDL into a real project and running `mx check` (0 errors). Tests `mdl/executor/odata_auth_microflow_test.go`. mxcli-formula1 §40
